_comment: Exact per-iteration allocation budgets in bytes (GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread, Release). Zero-alloc paths use bytesPerIteration 0. String-library scenarios budget the single result allocation: resultLength is the result's byte length (a Lua string is one byte[] with an 8-byte header, so the result costs 24 + round8(8 + resultLength) bytes). excessBytes records allocation beyond that single result in the current implementation (a known gap against spec ticket 17 decision 3: the target is 0); it may only be lowered, and raising it needs a PR citing before/after numbers; CODEOWNERS enforces.
